reason: The shared-agent-layer need is real for my team, but $30/seat adds up fast with 10+ agents, and I never buy a dev tool on first exposure — I read every review and check Reddit, GitHub issues, and Twitter first, and there's nothing to check yet.
objection: $30/seat adds up fast when I have 10+ agents, and I have no community signal — no reviews, no GitHub issues, no Reddit threads — to validate it.
would_change_my_mind: Real team reviews on Reddit/GitHub plus a free pilot I can script against before committing.
